title: The Sales report shows the same figures as before the release
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Use staging, where data from before the release is kept; the QA site only if its data predates the release; the production test account only if neither has data from before the release.
  • Note the attached Today picture shows this screen before the release; the steps check that it still works the same way.
  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access'.
  • Before the release is deployed to staging, note the Sales report's totals for last month at one location (for example Parts and Labor totals).
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. After the deploy, open Reports › Sales.
  2. Pick last month and the same location.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales opens as today.

Step 2:

  • Every noted total reads the same, to the cent (noted − now = $0.00).

AUTOMATION: HOLD - needs data made on staging before the Tiered Pricing release is deployed there; run on staging after the deploy
